Role Purpose

The purpose of the Retail & Store System Integration role is to serve as the strategic architect of the IOH Retail & Store System (Owned Store, Direct Sales, Partner Store) journey including supporting system such as (POSS, Queueing System, Digital Vending Machine, Siebel, Logistic/ERP), ensuring the application is both a commercial powerhouse and a user-friendly tool.

• Conduct deep-dive assessments of IOH Retail & Store Application Ecosystem (POSS, Queueing Management, Digital Vending Machine) and user feedback to identify friction points within the application, translating complex metrics into actionable development insights.
• Lead an iterative "test and learn" approach, consistently refining application features to stay ahead of evolving technology and shifting market demands.
• Prioritize the user experience to ensure the application isn't just functional but also fostering trust and stability from daily use by Agent & Customer.
• Ensuring all technical implementations are aligned with broader commercial objectives, contributing to the bottom line and maintaining a competitive edge in the market.
• Orchestrate complex project timelines and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality application enhancements on schedule and within scope.
• Scope

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Software Development & Delivery Leadership

• Lead and manage agile development teams delivering retail platform features
• Oversee the full software development lifecycle (planning, coding, testing, deployment)

Product & Business Alignment

• Work closely with business users to understand feature requirements and business goals
• Translate business needs into clear technical solutions and implementation plans
• Prioritize technical deliverables to balance speed, quality, and value

Platform Modernization & Innovation

• Drive modernization initiatives such as microservices, API-first design, and cloud-native solutions
• Explore and incorporate emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, personalization, real-time analytics)
• Promote continuous improvement through innovation and technical excellence

Requirements

Qualification:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or equivalent field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience working in delivering Retail Store Ecosystem (POSS, Queueing System, Digital Vending Machine) and digital solutions, especially on mobile and web-based applications
• Deep knowledge of Siebel CRM, Logistic/ERP & eKYC Biometric Verification Technology
• Deep knowledge of system integration using common communication methods such as SOAP and JSON
• Knowledge and able to work with Agile Approach
• Team player on project-based delivery
• Understanding security principles integrating single page apps, mobile apps, and third-party systems using OAuth2, SSO, JWT.
• Understanding of Microservices architecture and patterns, micro gateway, docker, Kubernetes fundamental.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills and capabilities
• Target oriented problem-solving approach and decision-making capabilities.
• Deep knowledge on navigating the UI/UX requirement using Figma and translates into technical requirements.

Experience:

• Minimum 5 years' hands-on experience in solutioning, architecting and delivering mobile app and website products.
• Product Development, Product management capability, especially on telecommunication industry
• Preferably had various assignments in different functions in Marketing or having experience in working in highly dynamic companies
• Deep understanding of the telecommunication and competitive landscape in Indonesia
• Highly experienced in leading cross functional teams

Skills:

• Agile leaner and responsive to feedback
• Collaborative team player
• Ability to plan holistically
• Quality & Results Orientation

Proactive to ensure goals are met and we stay ahead of the competition
